description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordDecorator class, which encapsulates additional presentation and utility methods around the core AttendanceRecord entity, including timezone conversions, formatted date strings, and employee assignment methods within an HR management system.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds presentation and timezone conversion methods for the AttendanceRecord entity within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an AttendanceRecord entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the attendance record using employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceState
methods.description: Returns the attendance state as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in date in user timezone as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in time in user timezone as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCtime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out date in user timezone as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out time in user timezone as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user timezone DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user timezone DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC DateTime object.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-out time.
